text:
Hannah (CS): quick one — I pulled triage notes from 3 new onboard accounts this week (Novara, Greenline, ParkCo). seeing 3 recurring asks that overlap product + onboarding: per-route billing visibility, resilient webhook delivery, and a simple model-fallback toggle for low-cost vs high-quality. wanted to surface for prioritization + renewals watch.

Diego (CS): +1 on per-route billing visibility. Novara flagged this as a blocker for finance sign-off. they need per-customer/per-route cost breakdown in the console or exports. :warning:

Maya (PM): can you paste the snippets or exact wording customers used? helps with framing PRD.

Hannah (CS): pasted verbatim from Novara: "we can't reconcile our usage by product line — currently everything aggregates at acct level, so we overpay on dev routes". Greenline also wants csv export + per-route filter. ParkCo specifically asked for a toggle to stop routing to 'large' models on nights to control spend.

Lena (Onboarding): ParkCo is on a pilot with a renewal review in 6 weeks. they tied the renewal conversation to predictable spend — makes this higher risk. I recommended a temp workaround: set a stricter quota and scheduled off-peak jobs. they want a longer-term UI control.

Aaron (Eng): for webhook delivery backpressure, can we confirm whether this is (a) retries on 5xx vs (b) client-side throttling? small code example customers sent: ```json
{"webhook": "https://hooks.example.com/ingest", "retry_policy": "exponential: 500ms, 2s, 8s, 30s"}```

Diego (CS): it's mostly (a) downstream endpoint 503s and our queue growth alarms firing. customers see delayed callbacks and duplicate events. they asked for a docs page + dashboard metric for webhook queue length.

Maya (PM): prioritization thoughts: per-route billing is high business value (finance sign-off), moderate effort. webhook resiliency is high ops value, small-medium effort. model-fallback toggle is low effort but high perceived impact for pilot customers. propose: 1) quick UI toggle + API flag for fallback (2w), 2) webhook metrics + small retry improvements (2-3w), 3) per-route billing export + console filter (3-5w).

Hannah (CS): that sequence sounds great. ParkCo renewal: if we ship fallback toggle + quota changes this sprint, should reduce churn risk.

Lena (Onboarding): I'll update the renewal playbook for ParkCo and schedule an enablement call demoing the toggle once Aaron's team has an internal preview.

Aaron (Eng): I'll prototype an API param: `fallback_policy: "cost_prefer" | "quality_prefer"` and a simple per-route override. sample curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"route_id":"r-123","fallback_policy":"cost_prefer"}'
```

Maya (PM): thanks — can you add a rough estimate in JIRA ticket we create? I'll spin up an epic and put these three as child tickets.

ops-bot: created ticket RW-4123: "per-route billing export" assigned to Maya (PM) :white_check_mark:

Diego (CS): tagging customer notes with `onboard-ask` and `renewal-risk` so we can query later. also attaching the CSV of customer quotes to the ticket.

Hannah (CS): action items: Lena to run renewal playbook for ParkCo, Aaron to PR API toggle draft, Maya to create epic + priority, Diego to attach quotes and update ticket. Meeting? 30m sync tomorrow to confirm timelines. :calendar:

Maya (PM): 10am PT tomorrow works for me. I'll add agenda: demo toggle spec, webhook metrics proposal, minimal per-route export schema.

Lena (Onboarding): I'll invite ParkCo's CS contact to the demo if that's helpful.

Aaron (Eng): will have a rough branch and docs stub by EOD Monday.

Diego (CS): sounds good. I'll use the roadmap signals channel to flag these as near-term. :thumbsup:
